meta.title: @remotion/renderer: Improved render time estimates
meta.body_summary: Improve renderEstimatedTime calculation in render-media.ts by switching from a full cumulative average to a rolling window of the most recent 50 frame timings to eliminate cold-start bias.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot improved render time estimation with a rolling window of 50 frame timings; maintainer approved immediately without comments and merged after minor code deletions.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 517 changed lines this is a small-to-medium edit, but the core performance change is only ~19 lines in render-media.ts; the rest is noise from merging main and version bumps. The PR is a focused performance tweak that merged successfully with quick approval and minor maintainer cleanup.

review_details.concern_detail: No concerns raised; maintainer approved without any textual feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Using a rolling average of the last 50 frame render times instead of the overall average produces more accurate and adaptive render time estimates, eliminating initial cold-start bias.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A straightforward rolling-window algorithm for time estimation; Copilot could implement it without special evidence, and maintainer merged with minor tweaks.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer JonnyBurger likely reviewed the diff visually, approved within ~18 minutes without requesting additional evidence, and later made minor code deletions.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after timing data or benchmark provided; the improvement is based on algorithmic intuition and narrative.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression issues; maintainer made two small deletions after approval, possibly for cleanup.

core_change_summary.description: In packages/renderer/src/render-media.ts, replaced the cumulative average of all frame timings with a rolling window of the last 50 frame timings. Added recentFrameTimings array and a constant MAX_RECENT_FRAME_TIMINGS = 50, updating renderEstimatedTime calculation accordingly.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The merge of main brought in extensive unrelated changes including version bumps in many package.json files and documentation updates.
change_trajectory: Initial Copilot commit: implement rolling window estimation with recentFrameTimings and MAX_RECENT_FRAME_TIMINGS = 50.
Maintainer merges main branch, pulling in many unrelated updates.
Maintainer makes two small deletions in render-media.ts (likely removing extraneous code).
